decision_rule: Judge coverage of this dimension over valid_interval, not whether future plans have happened. List blocking_findings only for a source-backed opening mismatch, confirmed missing in-scope change, or a required source genuinely absent. With adequate opening sources and no such blocker, use PASS; unrelated historical unknowns and proposed future status stay informational. REVIEW must identify a concrete in-scope blocker, not merely annotate planning status.
